name: DVL v0.4
description: This item contains the DVL v0.4 Replication Kit for independent testing of the Discovery & Validation Layer (DVL) prior-art retrieval benchmark.The package is designed to allow other users to reproduce the same benchmark independently and compare results against the original public v0.4 run.The benchmark evaluates whether DVL can distinguish obvious high-prior-art claims from composite DVL claims that do not produce strong title-level prior-art matches in the retrieved Crossref metadata.Original public benchmark result:6/6 completed 6/6 expected classifications 100% accuracy 0 API errorsThe Replication Kit includes the benchmark definition, expected classifications, reproducibility metadata, and files required to repeat the test.Important scientific boundary:This benchmark measures prior-art retrieval classification only. A LOW prior-art risk result does not prove novelty, scientific truth, safety, usefulness, or patentability. Broader literature review, patent searching, domain-expert evaluation, and independent testing remain necessary.The Replication Kit is associated with the public DVL Concept v1.0:DOI: 10.6084/m9.figshare.33476239The purpose of this release is to enable independent reproduction, criticism, and falsification of the DVL v0.4 benchmark rather than to claim that DVL has already been scientifically validated
